title: Flint, MOSS-Image, and a chat-only install

features.title: Flint
features.summary: Recursive's 40B coding-agent MoE runs in 24 GB at 3-bit.

features.title: MOSS-Image
features.summary: A 5.1B image model for top-tier generation, as GGUF and FP8.

new: MLX MoE models too big for memory keep experts on SSD, so Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs on a 32 GB Mac.
A much smaller chat-only Desktop for GGUF chat. Add training later in Settings.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B scores 63.2 on Tau2-Bench vs the original's 38.7.
Export a smaller MoE by pruning 25% or 50% of its least useful experts with REAP.
improved: A more consistent UI across Unsloth.
